title: Two Sum
description:
Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.
hints: Try using a hash map for O(n) lookup.

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is the range [0, 5000].
hints: Iteratively keep track of prev, curr, and next pointers.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.
hints: Use a stack. Push expected closing brackets.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values (i.e., from left to right, level by level).
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 2000].
hints: Use a queue for Breadth-First Search. Process level sizes in a loop.

title: LRU Cache
description:
Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache.

Implement the LRUCache class with get(key) and put(key, value) in O(1) average time complexity.
constraints: At most 2 * 10^5 calls to get and put.
hints: Combine a Doubly Linked List with a Hash Map.
